Name: AT Towel
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy is one of my favorite books series. So, I wanted to add some stuff from it to Stardew Valley. I will be releasing several mods that add various items and references to that amazing book series and radio series. This mod is an AT of the Monster Rug to 50 different towels, 25 colors, each facing two different directions.

You can place the towels outside with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10192]Atra's Interaction Tweaks[/url]!

Thank you so much to Douglas Adams for creating the radio series and book series of Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, which was the inspiration for this mod. Rest In Peace, Douglas Adams.

Downloads.Description: Adds 50 retextures of the Monster Rug to towels.
